name: spectral evolution method
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 以统计谱随时间的变化表征随机激励或几何状态演化的方法。
usage_overview: 在轨道不平顺随时间演化的随机分析中，利用相邻检测时刻之间的谱增量统计更新不平顺功率谱，为考虑轨道几何状态时间变化的列车—轨道—桥梁耦合分析提供激励描述。

complete_examples.text: Based on the spectral evolution method, predictions for the long-term behaviors of train-track-bridge systems can be estimated.

The spectral evolution method developed in Section 3.3 is validated to be fairly practical, which can be used to statistically reveal the time-evolving process of track irregularities, and having been reported in a key project of The National Natural Science Fund of China [39] with specific to the vehicle-track system.
